title: League of Legends Early Game Prediction
description: An exploratory analysis and machine learning modeling of early-game League of Legends data, featuring feature engineering, visualization, and win prediction using logistic regression.

title: Recipe Analysis
description: This project captures various steps of analysis, starting from exploratory data analysis to hypothesis testing, creation of baseline models, and concluding with fairness analysis.

title: DSC 106 Project 2
description: Visualizations created to convey two sides of a proposition. The project involves a dataset with aid assistance, and country GDP information.
